The 150-fit view preserves original benchmark bindings and historical 127-fit tables. Raw process bodies, pressure-field archives and model weights are not copied into this chart evidence.

**Method.** A 370,016-parameter linear, bias-free F32 multiscale pressure CNN with one physically scaled residual channel and 19 weight tensors. Two shared neural pressure corrections recompute the F64 sealed cubic-grid equation residual, apply fixed train-only scales and accumulate cell-zero-gauged F64 pressure. Inherited GroupNorm/SiLU labels do not describe its executed linear blocks. It returns pressure, not a physical simulation step; no learned spatial coarse branch is present.

**Purpose.** Qualify a prospective typed pressure fit, exact checkpoint/profile publication and one already-consumed bound field probe.

**Experiment.** 1 CUDA Adam updates, batch one, rate 0.001, model seed 20261015, physical-index seed 2026102501, schedule []. Sixteen physical fitting trajectories/32 frames at 8/16 cells per metre, dt=1/60 s and fluid density 1000 kg/m3. Both manufactured banks and the fixed captured-direction bank remain active; First/final low-spatial-mode feedback weight is 0. The actual entrypoint is typed_pressure_evidence.py; diagnostics use training parents only. The typed evidence wrapper also queries one already-consumed validation frame for publication; it supplies no independent holdout.

**Observed outcome.** On the common 128 consumed old-solver pressure requests, worst mean-free pressure relative L2 is 0.641487 and worst equation residual relative L2 is 1.35042. Median case GPU latency is 4.40112 ms per pressure request; the largest case median is 4.71549 ms/request. Two fresh process phases preserve every input, reference and output hash, the original final learned tensors and the captured default pressure policy. These are pressure proposals, not complete simulation steps or independent holdout results.

**Lesson.** Keep lifecycle qualification, completed optimizer budgets and scientific accuracy qualification distinct. Repeating an unchanged fit for publication or scheduling can reproduce parameter bytes without creating new scene diversity or an architectural improvement. Byte-equal weights may share retained storage later, but original fit/Run evidence remains separate. A one-update smoke is not a full training result or generalization test. The common benchmark now quantifies this retained default policy; its training objective and smoke/publication duration are not pressure accuracy or deployment latency. Use the recorded same-request errors and complete pressure-call cost when deciding whether to retain or extend this design.

**Reproduction.** Retain the exact typed entrypoint and its explicit recipe source bindings, original config/runtime/source witness, all physical/manufactured/captured inputs, train-only scales, draw order and both checkpoints. Preserve native profile renaming and any original consumed publication probe. The historical training and publication paths still need GPU-only replay qualification; the separate original-checkpoint GPU evaluation and timing are now qualified. No original receipt alias, Trial ancestry or scientific scalar is rewritten. Clean retraining/new-Rheon generation and long own-history drift remain pending. The exact original-training-output CUDA evaluation is now qualified on all 128 cases with original_train_pressure_accuracy_02.py and two fresh timing phases with original_train_pressure_timing.py. Independent NumPy accuracy and stdlib timing reductions retain exact original sources, tensors and outputs. This does not qualify clean training, historical CPU restore/publication paths, new-Rheon regeneration or long drift.
